name: kernel-tileir-optimization
author: NVIDIA
description: Optimize existing Triton kernels for NVIDIA TileIR backend on Blackwell GPUs (sm_100+). Adds TileIR-specific autotune configs: occupancy, num_ctas, TMA descriptors. Covers kernel classification (dot-related, norm-like, elementwise, reduction), type-specific transformations, and PTX-vs-TileIR benchmarking. Triggered by: "optimize for TileIR", "add TileIR configs", "Blackwell optimization", "TMA descriptors", "2CTA mode", "occupancy tuning". Kernels use standard `import triton`; TileIR activates via ENABLE_TILE=1 when nvtriton is installed.
